verdict.rationale: Machine-payment protocol support is a fair question for a crypto payments platform like MoonPay, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions x402, ACP, MPP, or AP2, whether as endpoints, SDKs, or even aspirations. The documented MCP server only lets AI agents search and retrieve documentation content; it is an adjacent capability, not a machine-payment protocol.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform speaks the machine-payment protocols by name — x402, ACP, MPP, or AP2 support documented with endpoints or SDKs, not just a blog aspiration
